authority: CEO Round 87 directive: 'The gate should never report PASS when only the derivative has been validated. Use explicit states: DERIVED → IMPLEMENTED → NUMERICALLY VERIFIED → SOLVER-INTEGRATED → CROSS-SOLVER VERIFIED.'
purpose: Make the distinction between partial and complete tangent validation machine-readable. A check is TRUE (PASS) only when its evidence state is CROSS_SOLVER_VERIFIED. All lower states are explicit non-passing states.

NOT_STARTED.description: No work done on this check yet.
NOT_STARTED.example: Tangent not derived; only stress was known.

DERIVED.description: Analytical derivation exists on paper/file. The mathematical formula has been derived and verified against independent numerical differentiation of the analytical formula.
DERIVED.example: Log-J tangent formula derived (Round 86). Verified against scipy.misc.derivative to 0.0001%.

IMPLEMENTED.description: Code exists implementing the derivation. The implementation output matches the analytical formula at multiple deformation states.
IMPLEMENTED.example: Custom tan_mod_function written (Round 88). Verified against analytical to 0.004% at 5 states (Round 88c, after fixing the factor-of-2 bug).

NUMERICALLY_VERIFIED.description: Implementation output matches independent numerical differentiation of the implementation's stress output at multiple deformation states. This catches implementation bugs that derivation-only verification cannot.
NUMERICALLY_VERIFIED.example: Numerical FD of stress_function matches analytical to 0.004% at 5 states (Round 88c). The factor-of-2 bug in tan_mod_function was caught by comparing tan_mod_function output against numerical FD of stress_function.

SOLVER_INTEGRATED.description: Confirmed that the Newton solver actually USES this implementation (not an inherited or default tangent). This requires inspecting the solver's internal matrix assembly or extracting the tangent via a solver-internal API.
SOLVER_INTEGRATED.example: PENDING. The custom tan_mod_function is registered, but we have not yet confirmed that SfePy's Newton solver uses it (vs. falling back to BulkPenaltyTLTerm's tangent). SfePy's public evaluate() API does not expose tan_mod for hyperelastic terms.

CROSS_SOLVER_VERIFIED.description: Both solvers (A and B) reach SOLVER_INTEGRATED for this check, AND their tangents agree at all required deformation states.
CROSS_SOLVER_VERIFIED.example: PENDING. Requires FEBio rebuild and tangent extraction.

check_1_strain_energy_density.rationale: Both solvers use identical SED formula. Verified by character-by-character comparison.

check_2_stress_law.rationale: Both solvers produce identical stress expressions. Multi-state verification (5 states) completed; SfePy matches analytical to 0.004%.

check_3_tangent_equivalence.rationale: Tangent DERIVED (Round 86), IMPLEMENTED (Round 88c, after bug fix), NUMERICALLY VERIFIED (Round 88c, 3-way verification to 0.004%). NOT yet SOLVER_INTEGRATED (Newton solver's use of the custom tangent not confirmed) and NOT yet CROSS_SOLVER_VERIFIED (FEBio tangent not extracted).

check_4_compressibility_formulation.rationale: DECIDED to open new benchmark lineage B005 (pure displacement for both solvers). For B004, this check is NOT_STARTED (will never be CROSS_SOLVER_VERIFIED because mixed vs pure displacement cannot be proven equivalent). For B005, will be CROSS_SOLVER_VERIFIED by construction.

check_5_parameter_mapping.rationale: Parameter mapping is identical and verified.

check_6_stress_measure.rationale: Push-forward transformation derived and applied at 5 states. SfePy Cauchy stress (after push-forward) matches analytical to 0.004%. NOT yet CROSS_SOLVER_VERIFIED because FEBio stress measure not yet extracted and compared.

check_7_quadrature.rationale: Both solvers use 2x2x2 Gauss for hex8.

check_9_loading_path_equivalence.rationale: Only 5 points verified for SfePy, 0 for FEBio. Need >= 10 points for both solvers.

key_finding_round_88: The three-way tangent verification (Round 88c) caught a factor-of-2 bug in the tan_mod_function implementation. The bug was invisible to stress-only verification (stress_function was correct) and to derivation-only verification (the derivation was correct). Only the three-way comparison (analytical vs tan_mod_function vs numerical FD of stress_function) exposed the discrepancy. This validates the CEO's insistence on multi-method verification: 'Do not count one derivation twice.'
next_steps_to_advance_check_3: STEP 1: Confirm SfePy Newton solver uses the custom tan_mod_function (SOLVER_INTEGRATED). This requires either: (a) instrumenting the SfePy Newton solver to log which tan_mod_function is called; (b) comparing Newton iteration counts between v1 (inherited tangent) and v2 (custom tangent) — if they differ, the custom tangent is being used; (c) extracting the assembled Newton matrix and inspecting its entries.
STEP 3: Extract FEBio material tangent at 5 deformation states (via finite-difference on FEBio stress output at two nearby states, OR via FEBio's material tangent API if exposed).
STEP 4: Compare FEBio tangent vs analytical vs SfePy tangent at all 5 states. If agreement < 1%, check #3 reaches CROSS_SOLVER_VERIFIED.
